# 74148 - 8-line-to-3-line priority encoder (equal to 9318)

Package DIP-16 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74148.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74148.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 28 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![74148 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/74148.png) | ![74148 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-74148.png) | ![74148 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-74148.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Active | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 16 | VCC | power |  |  | +5 V |
| 8 | GND | ground |  |  |  |
| 10 | 0 | input |  |  | data input, active low, lowest priority |
| 11 | 1 | input |  |  | data input, active low |
| 12 | 2 | input |  |  | data input, active low |
| 13 | 3 | input |  |  | data input, active low |
| 1 | 4 | input |  |  | data input, active low |
| 2 | 5 | input |  |  | data input, active low |
| 3 | 6 | input |  |  | data input, active low |
| 4 | 7 | input |  |  | data input, active low, highest priority |
| 5 | EI | enable | low |  | controls pins 9, 7, 6, 14, 15; when not enabled: high |
| 9 | A0 | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 7 | A1 | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 6 | A2 | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 14 | GS | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 15 | EO | output |  | totem-pole |  |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 6 | A2 = NOT(EI' AND (4' OR 5' OR 6' OR 7')) | Low when enabled and any of inputs 4-7 is low. |
| 7 | A1 = NOT(EI' AND (7' OR 6' OR (5 AND 4 AND 3') OR (5 AND 4 AND 2'))) | Inverted bit 1 of the number of the highest-numbered low input. |
| 9 | A0 = NOT(EI' AND (7' OR (6 AND 5') OR (6 AND 4 AND 3') OR (6 AND 4 AND 2 AND 1'))) | Inverted bit 0 of the number of the highest-numbered low input. |
| 14 | GS = NOT(EI' AND (0' OR 1' OR 2' OR 3' OR 4' OR 5' OR 6' OR 7')) | Low when enabled and at least one data input is low. |
| 15 | EO = NOT(EI' AND 0 AND 1 AND 2 AND 3 AND 4 AND 5 AND 6 AND 7) | Low when enabled and no data input is low; feeds EI of the next lower-priority stage. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 16 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -0.8 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | Input 0 is a double load: IIL -3.2 mA max, IIH 80 uA (Req 2 kOhm); other inputs IIL -1.6 mA, IIH 40 uA. |
